nameEn: Manufacture of cutlery, hand tools and general hardware
description: This class includes the manufacture of cutlery, hand tools and general hardware of metal.
includes: manufacture of cutlery: knives, forks, spoons, ladles, skimmers, fish slices, cake servers, fish knives, butter knives, tongs
manufacture of razors and razor blades
manufacture of hand tools: pliers, screwdrivers, wrenches, spanners, hammers, files, rasps, saws
manufacture of interchangeable tools for hand tools or machine tools: drills, punches, milling cutters, turning tools
manufacture of agricultural hand tools: spades, shovels, rakes, scythes, sickles, forks, hoes
manufacture of locks, padlocks and keys
manufacture of hinges, castors and similar hardware
manufacture of safes, armoured doors etc.
manufacture of steel wool and iron or steel pot-scourers
excludes: manufacture of machines for sharpening tools, see 2818
manufacture of professional medical instruments and cutlery, see 3250
